title: Zeb Orrelios
description: Garazeb "Zeb" Orrelios was the muscle of the Ghost crew. A Lasat, Zeb thought that his people had been killed by the machinations of Agent Kallus and the Galactic Empire. Zeb influenced Kallus to leave the empire and join the Rebellion. After the war, Zeb revealed a delightful discovery to Kallus: Lina San, a world of Lasat survivors.
